# Security Checklist: First Seed Journey local one-time bootstrap

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the one-time bootstrap surface, session issuance and failure semantics
**Created**: 2026-11-20T01:36:00Z
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the eligibility condition for the first bootstrap stated without ambiguity? [Spec §FR-001, Assumption "zero organizations"]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all objects created by the bootstrap enumerated so partial initialization is detectable? [Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the constraints for organization name and administrator email specified before any write? [Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is "one-time" defined as a single successful initialization with explicit behavior for later attempts? [Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the administrator role scope quantified (role name, permission breadth, organization scope)? [Spec §Key Entities, Assumption "Admin role"]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the session's organization scope stated independently of the external identity flow? [Spec §FR-004, §FR-007]

## Consistency & Traceability

- [ ] CHK007 Are the bootstrap route and the existing login flow described as mutually exclusive paths with consistent success destinations? [Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the requirement for a session with `organizationId` align with the stated removal of the select-org step? [Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Are error outcomes consistently mapped across the API contract and UI requirements? [Spec §FR-009, §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria & Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Are measurable criteria defined for rejection after first use and for absence of partial objects? [Spec §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Are concurrency and duplicate-submission scenarios covered as acceptance scenarios rather than left to implementation discretion? [Spec §User Story 2, §FR-006, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the accepted risk of unverified email explicitly traceable to a stated limitation? [Spec §FR-012, §SC-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
